content:
设  
\[
L=\lim_{x\to+\infty}\left[\frac{x^n}{(x-1)(x-2)\cdots(x-n)}\right]^x
\]

取对数：
\[
\ln L=\lim_{x\to+\infty}x\ln\left[\frac{x^n}{(x-1)(x-2)\cdots(x-n)}\right]
\]

而
\[
\frac{x^n}{(x-1)(x-2)\cdots(x-n)}
=\prod_{k=1}^n\frac{x}{x-k}
=\prod_{k=1}^n\left(1-\frac{k}{x}\right)^{-1}
\]

当 \(x\to+\infty\) 时，
\[
\ln\left(1-\frac{k}{x}\right)^{-1}
=\frac{k}{x}+O\left(\frac1{x^2}\right)
\]

所以
\[
\ln\left[\frac{x^n}{(x-1)\cdots(x-n)}\right]
=\sum_{k=1}^n\left(\frac{k}{x}+O\left(\frac1{x^2}\right)\right)
=\frac{1+2+\cdots+n}{x}+O\left(\frac1{x^2}\right)
\]

因此
\[
x\ln\left[\frac{x^n}{(x-1)\cdots(x-n)}\right]
\to 1+2+\cdots+n=\frac{n(n+1)}2
\]

于是
\[
L=e^{\frac{n(n+1)}2}
\]

答案：C
